利用 Github Pages 免費架一個靜態網頁

Step 0: 靜態網頁 vs. 動態網頁

Step 1: 設定自動同步 readme.md & index.md 腳本

這種方式可以 讓你只維護 README.md，然後在每次 Git commit 前，自動產生對應的 index.md 作為 GitHub Pages 的首頁，非常適合開發者使用的 workflow 🚀

✅ 最終效果

每次你 git commit 前，Git 會：

  1. 讀取 README.md
  2. 在前面加上 Jekyll 的 front matter
  3. 輸出成 index.md 給 GitHub Pages 使用

🔧 教學步驟：建立 Git pre-commit hook

📁 步驟 1：建立 .git/hooks/pre-commit 檔案（或修改它）

  • Note: 從檔案總管找到pro-commit檔案，又鍵用vs code打開。
  • Note: pre-commit要設為LF檔，而不是CRLF。可以在vscode右下角設定。

在你的 repo 根目錄中，打開 terminal：

cd pages-med-utils/.git/hooks
nano pre-commit

或你可以用 VS Code/任何編輯器。

📝 步驟 2：貼上以下腳本內容

#!/bin/bash

# 這是 pre-commit hook，自動從 README.md 生成 index.md（含 Jekyll front matter）

echo "---" > index.md
echo "layout: default" >> index.md
echo "title: Home" >> index.md
echo "---" >> index.md
echo "" >> index.md

cat README.md >> index.md

echo "[pre-commit] index.md has been updated from README.md"

🔁 你可以根據實際需要修改 layout 或其他 front matter。

📛 步驟 3：賦予這個檔案執行權限

  • 可以跳過這一步驟，直接用下一步驟測試是否ok。 
    chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
  • 用這個步驟測試 ```bash bash .git/hooks/pre-commit [pre-commit] index.md has been updated from README.md —

🧪 步驟 4：測試一下！

  1. 編輯 README.md
  2. 執行：
git add .
git commit -m "Update README"

你會看到：

[pre-commit] index.md has been updated from README.md

然後 index.md 也自動更新啦 🎉

🔄 額外升級（可選）

如果你要讓這段 hook 能跨機使用或分享給其他人，也可以放到 .githooks/pre-commit 並設一個 core.hooksPath：

mkdir .githooks
mv .git/hooks/pre-commit .githooks/pre-commit
git config core.hooksPath .githooks

Step 2: 讓 markdown 檔案可以顯示在網頁上

簡易版本

  • 在 markdown 檔案最上方加上
---
layout: default
title: Home
---

Step 3: 插入圖片

方法二：用 site.url 和 site.baseurl（比較通用）

.md 或 HTML 裡寫上絕對路徑：

![for loop](/assets/images/tools/flowchart-for-loop.jpeg)

Step 4: 進階設定

1. 新增 RSS 訂閱功能透過加入 jekyll-feed 插件，讓讀者能訂閱你的部落格，獲得最新文章通知

設定方法： 在 _config.yml 中加入：

plugins:
  - jekyll-feed

2. 啟用文章分類與標籤使用 jekyll-archives 插件，將文章依照分類或標籤整理，方便讀者瀏覽特定主題的內容

設定方法： 在 _config.yml 中加入：

plugins:
  - jekyll-archives

3. 新增搜尋功能導入如 Lunr.js 的搜尋功能，讓讀者能快速找到感興趣的文章

4. 建立「關於我」頁面提供一個「關於我」頁面，介紹你的背景、專業領域或部落格的宗旨，增加讀者的信任感

📈 SEO 與社群分享優化

5. *完善 SEO 設定

使用 jekyll-seo-tag 插件，自動生成適當的 meta 標籤，提升搜尋引擎的收錄效。

設定方法： 在 _config.yml 中加入：

plugins:
  - jekyll-seo-tag

並在你的佈局檔案（如 _layouts/default.html）的 <head> 區塊中加：

<!-- Begin Jekyll SEO tag v2.9.0 -->
<title>Github Pages | Ian’s Blog</title>
<meta name="generator" content="Jekyll v4.4.1" />
<meta property="og:title" content="Github Pages" />
<meta property="og:locale" content="en_US" />
<link rel="canonical" href="https://liuyian.uk/zh/tools/github_pages/" />
<meta property="og:url" content="https://liuyian.uk/zh/tools/github_pages/" />
<meta property="og:site_name" content="Ian’s Blog" />
<meta property="og:type" content="website" />
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary" />
<meta name="twitter:title" content="Github Pages" />
<script type="application/ld+json">
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","headline":"Github Pages","url":"https://liuyian.uk/zh/tools/github_pages/"}</script>
<!-- End Jekyll SEO tag -->

6. *新增網站地圖

透過 jekyll-sitemap 插件，自動生成 sitemap.xml，幫助搜尋引擎更有效地索引你的網。

設定方法： 在 _config.yml 中加入：

plugins:
  - jekyll-sitemap

7. *整合社群分享功能

加入社群分享按鈕，讓讀者能輕鬆分享文章至 Facebook、Twitter 等平台，擴大曝光。

🎨 使用者體驗與設計建議

8. *優化行動裝置顯示

確保網站在手機和平板上也有良好的顯示效果。你可以使用 Google 的行動裝置友好測試工具 來檢查並化。

9. *自訂網站風格

透過修改 assets/css/style.scss，自訂網站的配色、字體等風格，讓部落格更具個人色。

📊 進階功能建議

10. 整合網站分析工

使用 Google Analytics 或其他分析工具，了解讀者的瀏覽行為，進一步優化內容佈局。

11. 啟用留言功

透過整合 Disqus 等第三方服務，讓讀者能在文章下方留言，增加動性。

Step 5: 外觀 (加入側邊欄, 程式碼區塊方框)

5.1 加入側邊欄

所有頁面都自動帶有 可折疊的目錄欄（TOC），需要 修改 _layouts/default.html，把 TOC 整合進每一頁的主架構。

5.1.0 最終資料夾結構

IanBlog/
├── _layouts/
│   └── default.html               ← 加入 TOC 結構的主模板
├── assets/
│   ├── css/
│   │   └── style.scss            ← 高亮 TOC 的 CSS
│   ├── js/
│   |   └── main.js               ← tocbot 的初始化腳本
|   └── images/
│
├── index.md                      ← 首頁（含目錄導引）
├── README.md                     ← GitHub repo 說明（可選）
│
├── {文章資料夾1}/
│   └── {文章1}.md
├── {文章資料夾2}/
│   ├── {文章2}.md
└── {文章資料夾3}/
    └── {文章3}.md

5.1.1 新增 _layouts/default.html

這邊是一個 簡潔、通用的 layout 結構，可以讓 TOC 固定在左側、內容在右側，自動作用於所有頁面：

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Github Pages</title>
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">

    <link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/css/style.css">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tocbot@4.20.1/dist/tocbot.css">

    <!-- Begin Jekyll SEO tag v2.9.0 -->
<title>Github Pages | Ian’s Blog</title>
<meta name="generator" content="Jekyll v4.4.1" />
<meta property="og:title" content="Github Pages" />
<meta property="og:locale" content="en_US" />
<link rel="canonical" href="https://liuyian.uk/zh/tools/github_pages/" />
<meta property="og:url" content="https://liuyian.uk/zh/tools/github_pages/" />
<meta property="og:site_name" content="Ian’s Blog" />
<meta property="og:type" content="website" />
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary" />
<meta name="twitter:title" content="Github Pages" />
<script type="application/ld+json">
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","headline":"Github Pages","url":"https://liuyian.uk/zh/tools/github_pages/"}</script>
<!-- End Jekyll SEO tag -->
 <!-- 如果有 jekyll-seo-tag -->
  </head>
  <body>
    <div style="display: flex; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1rem;">
      
      <nav class="js-toc" style="width: 250px; margin-right: 2rem; position: sticky; top: 1rem;"></nav>

        <h1 id="利用-github-pages-免費架一個靜態網頁">利用 Github Pages 免費架一個靜態網頁</h1>

<h2 id="step-0-靜態網頁-vs-動態網頁">Step 0: 靜態網頁 vs. 動態網頁</h2>
<p><img src="/assets/images/tools/static_vs_dynamic_web_page.jpg" alt="image" /></p>

<h2 id="step-1-設定自動同步-readmemd--indexmd-腳本">Step 1: 設定自動同步 readme.md &amp; index.md 腳本</h2>

<p>這種方式可以 <strong>讓你只維護 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">README.md</code></strong>，然後在每次 Git commit 前，自動產生對應的 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">index.md</code> 作為 GitHub Pages 的首頁，非常適合開發者使用的 workflow 🚀</p>

<hr />

<h3 id="-最終效果">✅ 最終效果</h3>
<p>每次你 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">git commit</code> 前，Git 會：</p>

<ol>
  <li>讀取 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">README.md</code></li>
  <li>在前面加上 Jekyll 的 front matter</li>
  <li>輸出成 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">index.md</code> 給 GitHub Pages 使用</li>
</ol>

<hr />

<h3 id="-教學步驟建立-git-pre-commit-hook">🔧 教學步驟：建立 Git pre-commit hook</h3>

<h4 id="-步驟-1建立-githookspre-commit-檔案或修改它">📁 步驟 1：建立 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">.git/hooks/pre-commit</code> 檔案（或修改它）</h4>

<ul>
  <li>Note: 從檔案總管找到pro-commit檔案，又鍵用vs code打開。</li>
  <li>Note: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">pre-commit</code>要設為<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">LF</code>檔，而不是<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">CRLF</code>。可以在vscode右下角設定。</li>
</ul>

<p>在你的 repo 根目錄中，打開 terminal：</p>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="nb">cd </span>pages-med-utils/.git/hooks
nano pre-commit
</code></pre></div></div>

<p>或你可以用 VS Code/任何編輯器。</p>

<hr />

<h4 id="-步驟-2貼上以下腳本內容">📝 步驟 2：貼上以下腳本內容</h4>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c">#!/bin/bash</span>

<span class="c"># 這是 pre-commit hook，自動從 README.md 生成 index.md（含 Jekyll front matter）</span>

<span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">"---"</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> index.md
<span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">"layout: default"</span> <span class="o">&gt;&gt;</span> index.md
<span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">"title: Home"</span> <span class="o">&gt;&gt;</span> index.md
<span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">"---"</span> <span class="o">&gt;&gt;</span> index.md
<span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">""</span> <span class="o">&gt;&gt;</span> index.md

<span class="nb">cat </span>README.md <span class="o">&gt;&gt;</span> index.md

<span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">"[pre-commit] index.md has been updated from README.md"</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<blockquote>
  <p>🔁 你可以根據實際需要修改 layout 或其他 front matter。</p>
</blockquote>

<hr />

<h4 id="-步驟-3賦予這個檔案執行權限">📛 步驟 3：賦予這個檔案執行權限</h4>

<ul>
  <li>可以跳過這一步驟，直接用下一步驟測試是否ok。
    <div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="nb">chmod</span> +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
</code></pre></div>    </div>
  </li>
  <li>用這個步驟測試
```bash
bash .git/hooks/pre-commit
[pre-commit] index.md has been updated from README.md
—</li>
</ul>

<h3 id="-步驟-4測試一下">🧪 步驟 4：測試一下！</h3>

<ol>
  <li>編輯 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">README.md</code></li>
  <li>執行：</li>
</ol>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>git add <span class="nb">.</span>
git commit <span class="nt">-m</span> <span class="s2">"Update README"</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<p>你會看到：</p>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="o">[</span>pre-commit] index.md has been updated from README.md
</code></pre></div></div>

<p>然後 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">index.md</code> 也自動更新啦 🎉</p>

<hr />

<h3 id="-額外升級可選">🔄 額外升級（可選）</h3>
<p>如果你要讓這段 hook 能跨機使用或分享給其他人，也可以放到 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">.githooks/pre-commit</code> 並設一個 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">core.hooksPath</code>：</p>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="nb">mkdir</span> .githooks
<span class="nb">mv</span> .git/hooks/pre-commit .githooks/pre-commit
git config core.hooksPath .githooks
</code></pre></div></div>

<h2 id="step-2-讓-markdown-檔案可以顯示在網頁上">Step 2: 讓 markdown 檔案可以顯示在網頁上</h2>

</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="-seo-與社群分享優化">📈 SEO 與社群分享優化</h3>

<h4 id="5-完善-seo-設定">5. <em>*完善 SEO 設定</em></h4>
<p>使用 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">jekyll-seo-tag</code> 插件，自動生成適當的 meta 標籤，提升搜尋引擎的收錄效。</p>

<p><strong>設定方法：</strong>
在 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">_config.yml</code> 中加入：</p>
<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="na">plugins</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="s">jekyll-seo-tag</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<p>並在你的佈局檔案（如 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">_layouts/default.html</code>）的 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">&lt;head&gt;</code> 區塊中加：</p>
<div class="language-html highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c">&lt;!-- Begin Jekyll SEO tag v2.9.0 --&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;title&gt;</span>Github Pages | Ian’s Blog<span class="nt">&lt;/title&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">name=</span><span class="s">"generator"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"Jekyll v4.4.1"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">property=</span><span class="s">"og:title"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"Github Pages"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">property=</span><span class="s">"og:locale"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"en_US"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;link</span> <span class="na">rel=</span><span class="s">"canonical"</span> <span class="na">href=</span><span class="s">"https://liuyian.uk/en/tools/github_pages/"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">property=</span><span class="s">"og:url"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"https://liuyian.uk/en/tools/github_pages/"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">property=</span><span class="s">"og:site_name"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"Ian’s Blog"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">property=</span><span class="s">"og:type"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"website"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">name=</span><span class="s">"twitter:card"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"summary"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">name=</span><span class="s">"twitter:title"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"Github Pages"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;script </span><span class="na">type=</span><span class="s">"application/ld+json"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>
<span class="p">{</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">@context</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">https://schema.org</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">@type</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">WebPage</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">headline</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">Github Pages</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">url</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">https://liuyian.uk/en/tools/github_pages/</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="nt">&lt;/script&gt;</span>
<span class="c">&lt;!-- End Jekyll SEO tag --&gt;</span>

</code></pre></div></div>

<h4 id="6-新增網站地圖">6. <em>*新增網站地圖</em></h4>
<p>透過 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">jekyll-sitemap</code> 插件，自動生成 sitemap.xml，幫助搜尋引擎更有效地索引你的網。</p>

<p><strong>設定方法：</strong>
在 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">_config.yml</code> 中加入：</p>
<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="na">plugins</span><span class="pi">:</span>
  <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="s">jekyll-sitemap</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h4 id="7-整合社群分享功能">7. <em>*整合社群分享功能</em></h4>
<p>加入社群分享按鈕，讓讀者能輕鬆分享文章至 Facebook、Twitter 等平台，擴大曝光。</p>

<hr />

<h3 id="-使用者體驗與設計建議">🎨 使用者體驗與設計建議</h3>

<h4 id="8-優化行動裝置顯示">8. <em>*優化行動裝置顯示</em></h4>
<p>確保網站在手機和平板上也有良好的顯示效果。你可以使用 <a href="https://search.google.com/test/mobile-friendly">Google 的行動裝置友好測試工具</a> 來檢查並化。</p>

<h4 id="9-自訂網站風格">9. <em>*自訂網站風格</em></h4>
<p>透過修改 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">assets/css/style.scss</code>，自訂網站的配色、字體等風格，讓部落格更具個人色。</p>

<hr />

<h3 id="-進階功能建議">📊 進階功能建議</h3>

<h4 id="10-整合網站分析工">10. <strong>整合網站分析工</strong></h4>
<p>使用 Google Analytics 或其他分析工具，了解讀者的瀏覽行為，進一步優化內容佈局。</p>

<h4 id="11-啟用留言功">11. <strong>啟用留言功</strong></h4>
<p>透過整合 <a href="https://disqus.com/">Disqus</a> 等第三方服務，讓讀者能在文章下方留言，增加動性。</p>

<h2 id="step-5-外觀-加入側邊欄-程式碼區塊方框">Step 5: 外觀 (加入側邊欄, 程式碼區塊方框)</h2>
<h3 id="51-加入側邊欄">5.1 加入側邊欄</h3>
<p>所有頁面都自動帶有 <strong>可折疊的目錄欄（TOC）</strong>，需要 <strong>修改 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">_layouts/default.html</code></strong>，把 TOC 整合進每一頁的主架構。</p>

<h4 id="510-最終資料夾結構">5.1.0 最終資料夾結構</h4>

<pre><code class="language-txt">IanBlog/
├── _layouts/
│   └── default.html               ← 加入 TOC 結構的主模板
├── assets/
│   ├── css/
│   │   └── style.scss            ← 高亮 TOC 的 CSS
│   ├── js/
│   |   └── main.js               ← tocbot 的初始化腳本
|   └── images/
│
├── index.md                      ← 首頁（含目錄導引）
├── README.md                     ← GitHub repo 說明（可選）
│
├── {文章資料夾1}/
│   └── {文章1}.md
├── {文章資料夾2}/
│   ├── {文章2}.md
└── {文章資料夾3}/
    └── {文章3}.md
</code></pre>

<h4 id="511-新增-_layoutsdefaulthtml">5.1.1 新增 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">_layouts/default.html</code></h4>

<p>這邊是一個 <strong>簡潔、通用的 layout 結構</strong>，可以讓 TOC 固定在左側、內容在右側，自動作用於所有頁面：</p>

<div class="language-html highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="cp">&lt;!DOCTYPE html&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;html</span> <span class="na">lang=</span><span class="s">"en"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;head&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">charset=</span><span class="s">"UTF-8"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;title&gt;</span>Github Pages<span class="nt">&lt;/title&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">name=</span><span class="s">"viewport"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"width=device-width, initial-scale=1"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>

    <span class="nt">&lt;link</span> <span class="na">rel=</span><span class="s">"stylesheet"</span> <span class="na">href=</span><span class="s">"/assets/css/style.css"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;link</span> <span class="na">rel=</span><span class="s">"stylesheet"</span> <span class="na">href=</span><span class="s">"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tocbot@4.20.1/dist/tocbot.css"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>

    <span class="c">&lt;!-- Begin Jekyll SEO tag v2.9.0 --&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;title&gt;</span>Github Pages | Ian’s Blog<span class="nt">&lt;/title&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">name=</span><span class="s">"generator"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"Jekyll v4.4.1"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">property=</span><span class="s">"og:title"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"Github Pages"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">property=</span><span class="s">"og:locale"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"en_US"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;link</span> <span class="na">rel=</span><span class="s">"canonical"</span> <span class="na">href=</span><span class="s">"https://liuyian.uk/en/tools/github_pages/"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">property=</span><span class="s">"og:url"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"https://liuyian.uk/en/tools/github_pages/"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">property=</span><span class="s">"og:site_name"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"Ian’s Blog"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">property=</span><span class="s">"og:type"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"website"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">name=</span><span class="s">"twitter:card"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"summary"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;meta</span> <span class="na">name=</span><span class="s">"twitter:title"</span> <span class="na">content=</span><span class="s">"Github Pages"</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;script </span><span class="na">type=</span><span class="s">"application/ld+json"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>
<span class="p">{</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">@context</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">https://schema.org</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">@type</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">WebPage</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">headline</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">Github Pages</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">url</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">https://liuyian.uk/en/tools/github_pages/</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="nt">&lt;/script&gt;</span>
<span class="c">&lt;!-- End Jekyll SEO tag --&gt;</span>
 <span class="c">&lt;!-- 如果有 jekyll-seo-tag --&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;/head&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;body&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;div</span> <span class="na">style=</span><span class="s">"display: flex; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1rem;"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>
      
      <span class="nt">&lt;nav</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"js-toc"</span> <span class="na">style=</span><span class="s">"width: 250px; margin-right: 2rem; position: sticky; top: 1rem;"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;/nav&gt;</span>

      <span class="nt">&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"js-toc-content"</span> <span class="na">style=</span><span class="s">"flex: 1;"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>
        <span class="nt">&lt;h1</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"git"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Git<span class="nt">&lt;/h1&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h2</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"local-repo-connect-to-a-remote-repository"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Local Repo Connect to a Remote Repository<span class="nt">&lt;/h2&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;ul&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git init<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git remote add origin <span class="ni">&amp;lt;</span>liink.git<span class="ni">&amp;gt;</span><span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git remote -v<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ul&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h2</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"first-pull--push-note"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>First Pull <span class="ni">&amp;amp;</span> Push Note<span class="nt">&lt;/h2&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;ul&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git pull origin main<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Pull latest changes from remote main branch<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git add .<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Add all new or changed files<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git commit -m "first commit"<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Commit changes with a message<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git branch<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Check current branch name<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git push -u origin {branch_name}<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Push to remote main branch and set upstream<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ul&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h2</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"basic-git-workflow-add-commit-and-push"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Basic Git Workflow: Add, Commit, and Push<span class="nt">&lt;/h2&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;ul&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git add .<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Stage all changes in working directory for the next commit.<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git commit -m '<span class="ni">&amp;lt;</span>message<span class="ni">&amp;gt;</span>'<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Save staged changes to the local repository with a descriptive message explaining what this commit does.<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git push<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Upload local commits to the remote repository (e.g., GitHub), making changes visible to others.<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ul&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h2</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"create-and-edit-a-gitignore-file"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Create and Edit a <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>.gitignore<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> File<span class="nt">&lt;/h2&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;ul&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>(wins) <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>New-Item -Path . -Name ".gitignore" -ItemType "File" -Force<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>(linux) <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>nano .gitignore<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>(mac)
    <span class="nt">&lt;ol&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>touch .gitignore<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Create .gitignore file<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>nano .gitignore<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Edit in terminal<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>press <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Ctrl + O<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Write out<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>press <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Enter<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Check file name correct<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>press <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Ctrl + x<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Exit nano editor<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;/ol&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ul&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h3</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"gitignore-content-example"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>.gitignore<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> content example<span class="nt">&lt;/h3&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-bash highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;pre</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;code&gt;&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"c"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span># .gitignore<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"k"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>*<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span>.tsv
<span class="nt">&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"k"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>*<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span>.geojson
<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h2</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"remove-a-file-from-tracking-keep-it-locally"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Remove a File from Tracking (Keep It Locally)<span class="nt">&lt;/h2&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;</span>Scenario: Already pushed a file to a GitHub repo but now want to remove it from version control - keeping it only on local maching and ignoring it in the future.<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;ol&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git rm --cached {file_name}<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Stop tracking the file(but keep it locally).<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>echo "{file_name}" <span class="ni">&amp;gt;&amp;gt;</span> .gitignore<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Add the file to <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>.gitignore<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> so it’s not tracked again.<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git add .gitignore<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: Stage the updated <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>.gitignore<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> file.<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git commit -m "{commit_message}"<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git push<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ol&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h2</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"retrieving-a-file-from-an-older-git-commit-without-overwriting-current-version"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Retrieving a File from an Older Git Commit (Without Overwriting Current Version)<span class="nt">&lt;/h2&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;ol&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;</span>Check file history:<span class="nt">&lt;/strong&gt;</span> <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git log -- Multinomial_naive_Bayes/main.py<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> → find the commit hash where the file was modified (e.g. <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>050e8222<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>).<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;</span>Extract old version:<span class="nt">&lt;/strong&gt;</span> <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git show 050e8222:Multinomial_naive_Bayes/main.py <span class="ni">&amp;gt;</span> Multinomial_naive_Bayes/main_old.py<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> → save the historical version as <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>main_old.py<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> without overwriting the current <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>main.py<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>.<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>(Optional) Add and commit the retrieved file: <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git commit -m "Add historical version of main.py from commit 050e8222"<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ol&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h2</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"git-branch-management"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Git Branch Management<span class="nt">&lt;/h2&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;ul&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>check current branch name: <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git branch<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>rename current branch locally: <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git branch -M {branch name}<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>delete old branch: <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git push origin --delete master<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>verify everthing: <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git branch -a<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>切換到新分支:<span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git checkout experiment<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ul&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h2</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"force-pull-from-a-git-remote-repository--discard-all-local-changes"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Force pull from a Git remote repository <span class="ni">&amp;amp;</span> discard all local changes<span class="nt">&lt;/h2&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;</span>To <span class="nt">&lt;strong&gt;</span>force pull from a Git remote repository<span class="nt">&lt;/strong&gt;</span> and <span class="nt">&lt;strong&gt;</span>discard all local changes<span class="nt">&lt;/strong&gt;</span>, follow these steps carefully. This will overwrite your local files and history with the latest from the remote, <span class="nt">&lt;strong&gt;</span>so make sure you’re okay with losing any uncommitted local work<span class="nt">&lt;/strong&gt;</span>.<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h2</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"compare-difference"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Compare difference<span class="nt">&lt;/h2&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;ul&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git diff --color-words {commit 版號開頭 1} {commit 版號開頭 2} -- {file}<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>Example: <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git diff --color-words 6d8d2361 7218ae5a3 -- ./Hofn.py<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ul&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;hr</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h3</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"-warning"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>🚨 WARNING:<span class="nt">&lt;/h3&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;</span>This process will <span class="nt">&lt;strong&gt;</span>delete all local changes<span class="nt">&lt;/strong&gt;</span>, including uncommitted and committed but not pushed changes.<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;hr</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h2</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"-steps-to-force-pull-and-recover-remote-repository"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>✅ Steps to Force Pull and Recover Remote Repository:<span class="nt">&lt;/h2&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h3</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"1-discard-uncommitted-changes-optional-but-recommended-if-youre-unsure"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;strong&gt;</span>1. Discard uncommitted changes (optional but recommended if you’re unsure):<span class="nt">&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-bash highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;pre</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;code&gt;</span>git reset <span class="nt">&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"nt"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>--hard<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span>
git clean <span class="nt">&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"nt"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>-fd<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;ul&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>reset --hard<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: resets tracked files to the last commit<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>clean -fd<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>: removes untracked files and directories<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ul&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;hr</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h3</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"2-fetch-latest-remote-data"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;strong&gt;</span>2. Fetch latest remote data:<span class="nt">&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-bash highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;pre</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;code&gt;</span>git fetch <span class="nt">&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"nt"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>--all<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h2</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"ssh--personal-access-token"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>SSH <span class="ni">&amp;amp;</span> Personal Access Token<span class="nt">&lt;/h2&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;ul&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>Personal Access Token 要用 https 的網址 clone<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>SSH 要用 ssh 的網址 clone<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ul&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h3</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"1-使用-https--personal-access-token建議"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>1. 使用 HTTPS + Personal Access Token（建議）<span class="nt">&lt;/h3&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;</span>如果你的 GitLab 是透過 HTTPS 存取（網址開頭為 <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>https://<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>），你需要在 clone 時提供：<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;ul&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;</span>帳號（Username）<span class="nt">&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;</span>個人存取權杖（Personal Access Token）<span class="nt">&lt;/strong&gt;</span> → 取代密碼使用<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ul&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h4</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"-步驟"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>🔧 步驟：<span class="nt">&lt;/h4&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;ol&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>登入 GitLab 網站 → 點右上角頭像 → <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Edit Profile<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> → <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Access Tokens<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> 或 <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Personal Access Tokens<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>建立一組 Token，至少包含：
    <span class="nt">&lt;ul&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>read_repository<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/li&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>write_repository<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>（如果有 push 需求）<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;/ul&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>使用指令 clone：
    <span class="nt">&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-bash highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;pre</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;code&gt;</span>git clone https://gitlab.company.com/your_group/your_repo.git
<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</span>    <span class="nt">&lt;/div&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>系統會提示輸入帳號與密碼：
    <span class="nt">&lt;ul&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;</span>Username<span class="nt">&lt;/strong&gt;</span> → 你的 GitLab 帳號<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;</span>Password<span class="nt">&lt;/strong&gt;</span> → 剛剛建立的 Token<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;/ul&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ol&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;blockquote&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;</span>💡 可將 Token 儲存在 Git Credential Manager 或 <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>.netrc<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> 中，避免每次輸入。<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/blockquote&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;hr</span> <span class="nt">/&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h3</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"2-使用-ssh-金鑰最方便"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>2. 使用 SSH 金鑰（最方便）<span class="nt">&lt;/h3&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;</span>如果你公司允許使用 SSH，你可以設定 SSH 金鑰來避免每次輸入密碼。<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h4</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"-步驟-1"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>🔧 步驟：<span class="nt">&lt;/h4&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;ol&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>在本機產生 SSH 金鑰（如果還沒有）：
    <span class="nt">&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-bash highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;pre</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;code&gt;</span>ssh-keygen <span class="nt">&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"nt"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>-t<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span> ed25519 <span class="nt">&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"nt"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>-C<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span> <span class="nt">&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"s2"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>"your_email@example.com"<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</span>    <span class="nt">&lt;/div&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;blockquote&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;</span>預設儲存於 <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>~/.ssh/id_ed25519<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;/blockquote&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>查看公開金鑰內容：
    <span class="nt">&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-bash highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;pre</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;code&gt;&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"nb"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>cat<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span> ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</span>    <span class="nt">&lt;/div&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>登入 GitLab，新增金鑰：
    <span class="nt">&lt;ul&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Edit Profile<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> → <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>SSH Keys<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> → 貼上 <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>id_ed25519.pub<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> 的內容<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;/ul&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>使用 SSH 方式 clone：
    <span class="nt">&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-bash highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;pre</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;code&gt;</span>git clone git@gitlab.company.com:your_group/your_repo.git
<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</span>    <span class="nt">&lt;/div&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ol&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;blockquote&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;</span>💡 第一次 clone 可能會提示確認主機指紋，輸入 <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>yes<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> 以信任該主機。<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/blockquote&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h3</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"-一檢查現有-ssh-金鑰"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>✅ 一、檢查現有 SSH 金鑰<span class="nt">&lt;/h3&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;</span>打開終端機（Terminal）後，輸入以下指令：<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-bash highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;pre</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;code&gt;&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"nb"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>ls<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span> ~/.ssh
<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h4</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"常見的金鑰檔案名稱"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>常見的金鑰檔案名稱：<span class="nt">&lt;/h4&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;table&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;thead&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;tr&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;th&gt;</span>檔案名稱<span class="nt">&lt;/th&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;th&gt;</span>說明<span class="nt">&lt;/th&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;/tr&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;/thead&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;tbody&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;tr&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>id_rsa<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/td&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;</span>傳統 RSA 私鑰<span class="nt">&lt;/td&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;/tr&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;tr&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>id_rsa.pub<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/td&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;</span>對應的公鑰<span class="nt">&lt;/td&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;/tr&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;tr&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>id_ed25519<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/td&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;</span>較新、建議使用的 ED25519 私鑰<span class="nt">&lt;/td&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;/tr&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;tr&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>id_ed25519.pub<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/td&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;</span>對應的公鑰<span class="nt">&lt;/td&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;/tr&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;tr&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>known_hosts<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/td&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;</span>連過的主機指紋<span class="nt">&lt;/td&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;/tr&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;tr&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>config<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/td&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;</span>SSH 設定檔<span class="nt">&lt;/td&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;/tr&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;/tbody&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/table&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h3</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"-二查看特定公鑰內容你要貼到-gitlab-的"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>✅ 二、查看特定公鑰內容（你要貼到 GitLab 的）<span class="nt">&lt;/h3&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;</span>如果你看到像是 <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>id_ed25519.pub<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> 或 <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>id_rsa.pub<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>，可以用以下指令查看內容：<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-bash highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;pre</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;code&gt;&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"nb"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>cat<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span> ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;</span>或<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-bash highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;pre</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;code&gt;&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"nb"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>cat<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span> ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;blockquote&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;</span>提示<span class="nt">&lt;/strong&gt;</span>：輸出的內容是你要複製並貼到 GitLab SSH Keys 頁面的公鑰文字。<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/blockquote&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h3</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"-查看曾經連過的-ssh-主機列表"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>🧾 查看曾經連過的 SSH 主機列表<span class="nt">&lt;/h3&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;</span>你可以透過查看 <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>~/.ssh/known_hosts<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> 檔案來列出曾經使用 SSH 連線過的主機。<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h4</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"-指令"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>✅ 指令<span class="nt">&lt;/h4&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-bash highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;pre</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"highlight"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;code&gt;&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"nb"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>cut<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span> <span class="nt">&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"nt"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>-f1<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span> <span class="nt">&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"nt"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>-d<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"s1"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>' '<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span> ~/.ssh/known_hosts | <span class="nt">&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"nb"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>sed<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span> <span class="nt">&lt;span</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"s1"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>'s/,.*//'<span class="nt">&lt;/span&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h4</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"-指令說明"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>🔍 指令說明<span class="nt">&lt;/h4&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;ul&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>cut -f1 -d' '<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>
➤ 取得每行空格前的第一欄（通常是主機名稱或 IP）<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>sed 's/,.*//'<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span>
➤ 去掉逗號後面的內容（處理多個主機名的情況，只保留主要主機名）<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ul&gt;</span>

<span class="nt">&lt;h2</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"note"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Note<span class="nt">&lt;/h2&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;ul&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>commit 階段 如果只下 <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>git commit<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> + <span class="nt">&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>enter<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> 可以進入預設的編輯器，這樣就可以一次commit多行<span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;li&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;p&gt;</span>asic Vim commands in this context<span class="nt">&lt;/p&gt;</span>

    <span class="nt">&lt;table&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;thead&gt;</span>
        <span class="nt">&lt;tr&gt;</span>
          <span class="nt">&lt;th&gt;</span>Action<span class="nt">&lt;/th&gt;</span>
          <span class="nt">&lt;th&gt;</span>Command<span class="nt">&lt;/th&gt;</span>
        <span class="nt">&lt;/tr&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;/thead&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;tbody&gt;</span>
        <span class="nt">&lt;tr&gt;</span>
          <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;</span>Enter insert mode<span class="nt">&lt;/td&gt;</span>
          <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>i<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/td&gt;</span>
        <span class="nt">&lt;/tr&gt;</span>
        <span class="nt">&lt;tr&gt;</span>
          <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;</span>Exit insert mode<span class="nt">&lt;/td&gt;</span>
          <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>Esc<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/td&gt;</span>
        <span class="nt">&lt;/tr&gt;</span>
        <span class="nt">&lt;tr&gt;</span>
          <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;</span>Save <span class="ni">&amp;amp;</span> quit editor<span class="nt">&lt;/td&gt;</span>
          <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>:wq<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> + Enter<span class="nt">&lt;/td&gt;</span>
        <span class="nt">&lt;/tr&gt;</span>
        <span class="nt">&lt;tr&gt;</span>
          <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;</span>Quit without save<span class="nt">&lt;/td&gt;</span>
          <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;&lt;code</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>:q!<span class="nt">&lt;/code&gt;</span> + Enter<span class="nt">&lt;/td&gt;</span>
        <span class="nt">&lt;/tr&gt;</span>
        <span class="nt">&lt;tr&gt;</span>
          <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;</span>Move cursor<span class="nt">&lt;/td&gt;</span>
          <span class="nt">&lt;td&gt;</span>Arrow keys<span class="nt">&lt;/td&gt;</span>
        <span class="nt">&lt;/tr&gt;</span>
      <span class="nt">&lt;/tbody&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;/table&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;/li&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/ul&gt;</span>

      <span class="nt">&lt;/div&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;/div&gt;</span>

    <span class="nt">&lt;script </span><span class="na">src=</span><span class="s">"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tocbot@4.20.1/dist/tocbot.min.js"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;/script&gt;</span> <span class="c">&lt;!-- TOC Script --&gt;</span>
    <span class="nt">&lt;script </span><span class="na">src=</span><span class="s">"/assets/js/main.js"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;/script&gt;</span>   <span class="c">&lt;!-- custom script --&gt;</span>

  <span class="nt">&lt;/body&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/html&gt;</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h4 id="note">Note:</h4>
<ul>
  <li><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">&lt;head&gt;</code>: 用來定義網頁的元數據，設置頁面標題、字符編碼、樣式、SEO 信息等，這些對頁面本身不可見，但對頁面的加載和優化非常重要。</li>
  <li><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">&lt;body&gt;</code>: 包含頁面的實際內容，這些內容會顯示在用戶的瀏覽器中。它包括頁面文本、圖片、導航欄、主內容等。</li>
</ul>

<h4 id="512-新增-assetscssstylescss">5.1.2 新增 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">assets/css/style.scss</code></h4>

<p>這樣可以讓目前閱讀區塊的目錄高亮顯示：</p>

<div class="language-scss highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="nc">.is-active-link</span> <span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="nl">font-weight</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">bold</span><span class="p">;</span>
  <span class="nl">color</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mh">#1a73e8</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h4 id="513-新增-assetsjsmainjs">5.1.3 新增 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">assets/js/main.js</code></h4>

<div class="language-js highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="nx">tocbot</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">init</span><span class="p">({</span>
  <span class="na">tocSelector</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">.js-toc</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="na">contentSelector</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">.js-toc-content</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="na">headingSelector</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="na">collapseDepth</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">6</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="na">scrollSmooth</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="na">orderedList</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">false</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">});</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h4 id="514-最後檢查一下每個-md-頁面都要有">5.1.4 最後檢查一下每個 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">.md</code> 頁面都要有：</h4>

<div class="language-markdown highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="p">
---</span>
layout: default
<span class="gh">title: 任意標題
---
</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<p>這樣才能套用我們剛剛改的 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">default.html</code>！</p>

<h3 id="52-解決插入sidebar後圖片變超大">5.2 解決插入sidebar後圖片變超大</h3>
<ul>
  <li>現象: <img src="/assets/images/tools/github_pages_image_size.jpg" alt="github_pages_image_size" /></li>
  <li>原因: 沒有限制圖片寬度</li>
  <li>解法: 在 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">assets/css/style.scss</code> 加入以下這段</li>
</ul>

<div class="language-css highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="nt">img</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="nl">max-width</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">100%</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">height</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">auto</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">display</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">block</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">margin</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">1rem</span> <span class="nb">auto</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="53-加入區塊程式碼方框markdown">5.3 加入區塊程式碼方框(markdown)</h3>

<div class="language-css highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c">/* Style for code blocks (surrounded by triple backticks ```) */</span>
<span class="nt">pre</span> <span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="nl">background</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nx">#f5f5f5</span><span class="p">;</span>       <span class="c">/* Light gray background */</span>
  <span class="nl">border</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">1px</span> <span class="nb">solid</span> <span class="nx">#ccc</span><span class="p">;</span>    <span class="c">/* Gray border */</span>
  <span class="nl">border-radius</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">6px</span><span class="p">;</span>
  <span class="nl">padding</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">1rem</span><span class="p">;</span>
  <span class="nl">overflow-x</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">auto</span><span class="p">;</span>          <span class="c">/* Enable horizontal scroll for overflow */</span>
  <span class="nl">font-family</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">Consolas</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Monaco</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">'Courier New'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">monospace</span><span class="p">;</span>
  <span class="nl">font-size</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">0.95rem</span><span class="p">;</span>
  <span class="nl">line-height</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">1.5</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c">/* Additional styling for code content */</span>
<span class="nt">code</span> <span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="nl">font-family</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">Consolas</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Monaco</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">'Courier New'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">monospace</span><span class="p">;</span>
  <span class="nl">font-size</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">0.95rem</span><span class="p">;</span>
  <span class="nl">color</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nx">#333</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c">/* Inline code styling (e.g. `example`) */</span>
<span class="nt">p</span> <span class="nt">code</span><span class="o">,</span> <span class="nt">li</span> <span class="nt">code</span> <span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="nl">background-color</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nx">#eee</span><span class="p">;</span>
  <span class="nl">padding</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">0.2em</span> <span class="m">0.4em</span><span class="p">;</span>
  <span class="nl">border-radius</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">3px</span><span class="p">;</span>
  <span class="nl">font-size</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">0.9em</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="54-使的側邊欄可收合">5.4 使的側邊欄可收合</h3>
<p>要讓你的 <strong>TOC 側邊欄可收合（可展開 / 收起）</strong>，我們可以加上一些簡單的 JavaScript 搭配 CSS 切換 class，以下是完整解法：</p>

<h4 id="-修改後的內容包括">✅ 修改後的內容包括：</h4>

<ol>
  <li>為側邊欄加上 <strong>切換按鈕</strong></li>
  <li>增加 <strong><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">.collapsed</code> class 的 CSS 控制樣式</strong></li>
  <li>加入 JavaScript 處理「收合 / 展開」行為</li>
</ol>

<hr />

<h4 id="541-修改-defaulthtml">5.4.1 <strong>修改 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">default.html</code></strong></h4>

<p>在 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">&lt;nav class="sidebar js-toc"&gt;</code> 外面包一個容器，加上一個按鈕：</p>

<div class="language-html highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c">&lt;!-- TOC 導覽欄容器 --&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;div</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"sidebar-wrapper"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;button</span> <span class="na">id=</span><span class="s">"toggle-sidebar"</span><span class="nt">&gt;</span>☰ Table of Contents<span class="nt">&lt;/button&gt;</span>
  <span class="nt">&lt;nav</span> <span class="na">class=</span><span class="s">"sidebar js-toc"</span><span class="nt">&gt;&lt;/nav&gt;</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/div&gt;</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<p><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">main.js</code> 改為：</p>

<div class="language-html highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="nt">&lt;script&gt;</span>
  <span class="c1">// 初始化 TOCBOT</span>
  <span class="nx">tocbot</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">init</span><span class="p">({</span>
    <span class="na">tocSelector</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">.js-toc</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="na">contentSelector</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">.js-toc-content</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="na">headingSelector</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="na">collapseDepth</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">6</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="na">scrollSmooth</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="na">orderedList</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">false</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="p">});</span>

  <span class="c1">// 切換側邊欄顯示 / 隱藏</span>
  <span class="nb">document</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">getElementById</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">toggle-sidebar</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="nf">addEventListener</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">click</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nf">function </span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="nb">document</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">querySelector</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">.sidebar</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="nx">classList</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">toggle</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">collapsed</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">);</span>
  <span class="p">});</span>
<span class="nt">&lt;/script&gt;</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h4 id="-修改-stylecss">🎨 <strong>修改 <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">style.css</code></strong></h4>

<div class="language-css highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c">/* 包住 sidebar 與切換按鈕的外框 */</span>
<span class="nc">.sidebar-wrapper</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="nl">display</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">flex</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">flex-direction</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">column</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">margin-right</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">2rem</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">position</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">sticky</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">top</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">1rem</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">align-self</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">flex-start</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c">/* 收合狀態下隱藏 TOC */</span>
<span class="nc">.sidebar.collapsed</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="nl">display</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">none</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c">/* TOC 切換按鈕 */</span>
<span class="nf">#toggle-sidebar</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="nl">background</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nx">#eee</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">border</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">1px</span> <span class="nb">solid</span> <span class="nx">#ccc</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">padding</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">0.5rem</span> <span class="m">1rem</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">margin-bottom</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">0.5rem</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">border-radius</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">4px</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">cursor</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">pointer</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">font-size</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">1rem</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="nl">text-align</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">left</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="k">@media</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">max-width</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">768px</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="nf">#toggle-sidebar</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="nl">width</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">100%</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<h3 id="55-處理手機板toc排版">5.5 處理手機板TOC排版</h3>

<div class="language-css highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="c">/* Responsive */</span>
<span class="k">@media</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">max-width</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="m">768px</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="nc">.container</span> <span class="p">{</span>
